summary: Spirit If... is the 2007 debut solo album by Kevin Drew, co-founder of Broken Social Scene. It is the first release in a series titled "Broken Social Scene Presents:", where each album features a member's solo work assisted by other Broken Social Scene members. The note also mentions that Brendan Canning's "Something for All of Us" was the second album in the series, released in 2008.
one_line: Spirit If... is Kevin Drew's 2007 debut solo album, the first in the Broken Social Scene Presents series.
key_facts: Spirit If... is the debut solo album by Broken Social Scene co-founder Kevin Drew.
Spirit If... was released on September 18, 2007.
Spirit If... is the first album in a series entitled "Broken Social Scene Presents:".
Each album in the "Broken Social Scene Presents:" series is a particular member's solo effort, assisted by fellow Broken Social Scene members.
Brendan Canning's album "Something for All of Us" is the second album in the series.
"Something for All of Us" was released in 2008.
